heading.title: Of Acceptance and Payment for Honour and Reference in Case of Need

article.title: Acceptance and payment without protest.
article.content:
116Acceptance and payment without protest.

Section 116  ·  Chapter XI  ·  page 24 of the Act
A drawee in case of need may accept and pay the bill of exchange without previous protest.
